rules.delete: No hard delete; ON DELETE/UPDATE RESTRICT; archive preserves history
rules.money: Exact PostgreSQL NUMERIC/Prisma Decimal; canonical decimal string on wire; never binary float; currency required when purchaseCost is present; no default currency or FX conversion
rules.supplier: Supplier is an external counterparty and is not SellerLegalEntity; no automatic name/identifier merge; canonical tax identity is jurisdiction-scoped and unique only among ACTIVE suppliers per OD-007A-01; archive preserves history and permits a distinct new registration.
rules.offerRevision: Every accepted content edit appends an immutable complete revision; currentRevisionId points to latest revision; source facts are nullable and never inferred

identity.brandId: Explicit FK to an existing ACTIVE R1-004 Brand; not inferred from text
identity.normalization: Same frozen R1-004 normalization: Unicode NFC and trim only outer U+0020; preserve case, internal whitespace, punctuation and hyphens; compare text with PostgreSQL COLLATE C
identity.unknownModification: UNKNOWN never matches NULL CatalogProduct.modification; CONFIRMED_NONE is an explicit human statement and may match NULL
identity.automaticMatch: Exact candidate only; no name similarity, supplierPartNumber substitution, analogues or auto-association

rules.matchProposal: Proposal decisions are immutable; a partial unique index permits at most one PENDING row per (offerId, offerRevisionId, proposedProductId), while REJECTED and APPROVED historical rows do not block a new proposal ID after rejection or unlink; same idempotency key replays its saved result; no automatic pointer restoration
rules.currentMatch: Effective only while current offer and CatalogProduct tuples both still equal the approved identity snapshots; otherwise derived REVIEW_REQUIRED and never usable for costing
rules.freshness: Explicit expiresAt wins; otherwise sourceObservedAt ?? recordedAt plus owner-approved configured window; no configured window means UNKNOWN
rules.concurrency: Root/proposal expectedVersion compare-and-swap; offer/product rows locked and identity revalidated in same transaction as decision and success AuditEvent
rules.audit: Success domain mutation and AuditEvent share one PostgreSQL transaction; audit payload excludes raw contact, note, source URL, purchase amount, credentials and request body
rules.visibility: Staff-only endpoints and no-store responses; no supplier fields or cost in Public DTOs

supplierTaxIdentity.pair: taxIdentifier and taxJurisdiction are both NULL or both non-NULL; jurisdiction is an uppercase valid ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 code
supplierTaxIdentity.RU: ASCII decimal string exactly 10 or 12 digits; preserve leading zeroes; validate the applicable Russian INN checksum: 10-digit weights [2,4,10,3,5,9,4,6,8], 12-digit first-check weights [7,2,4,10,3,5,9,4,6,8] applied to the first 10 digits, second-check weights [3,7,2,4,10,3,5,9,4,6,8] applied to the first 11 digits; each check digit equals (weighted sum mod 11) mod 10; do not trim or rewrite
supplierTaxIdentity.foreign: Unicode NFC then trim outer ASCII U+0020 only; preserve case, internal characters and leading zeroes; do not apply RU digit/length/checksum rules
supplierTaxIdentity.activeUniqueness: Partial unique index on (taxJurisdiction, taxIdentifier COLLATE C) where state=ACTIVE and taxIdentifier is not NULL
supplierTaxIdentity.archivedReRegistration: An identity held only by ARCHIVED suppliers may be created as a new ACTIVE Supplier with a new ID and independent history; never unarchive, merge or transfer history automatically

idempotency.scope: (actorStaffUserId, fixed scope R1-007, exact opaque Idempotency-Key string of 8-128 characters) across all supplier mutation routes
idempotency.canonicalRequestHash: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON containing API version, operationId, HTTP method, normalized path/query, authenticated actor ID and validated canonical DTO including expected versions; key is excluded from hash
idempotency.transaction: Serialize by PostgreSQL transaction-scoped advisory lock derived from exact actor/scope/key; domain write, successful AuditEvent, and completed sanitized HTTP status/body are committed atomically; the unique constraint is the durable backstop
idempotency.concurrentRequests: Same key requests wait for the first transaction; after commit same hash replays saved status/body and different hash returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; rollback permits one waiter to execute
idempotency.restartRetry: Completed records are durable in PostgreSQL and replay after API restart after authentication, CSRF/Origin, validation, and current permissions are rechecked
idempotency.versionConflict: Persist deterministic terminal OCC/domain 409 such as VERSION_CONFLICT without domain mutation or success audit; exact retry returns same 409; corrected expected version/payload requires a new key
idempotency.retention: Append-only and retained indefinitely in R1; no purge/expiry task

fields.currentRevisionId: uuid NOT NULL; composite FK (currentRevisionId, Supplier.id) -> SupplierRevision(id, supplierId), DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

checks: current root profile fields equal current SupplierRevision under deferred transaction guard
taxIdentifier and taxJurisdiction are both NULL or both non-NULL; taxJurisdiction is uppercase ISO-3166-1 alpha-2
RU taxIdentifier is exactly 10 or 12 ASCII digits as text with valid applicable INN checksum; leading zeroes are preserved and no trimming occurs
non-RU taxIdentifier is Unicode NFC with only outer ASCII U+0020 trimmed; no RU digit, length or checksum rule is applied
duplicate canonical (taxJurisdiction,taxIdentifier) conflicts only against ACTIVE suppliers; archived identity may be registered as a new supplier without merging history
Supplier.deletePolicy: No hard delete; archived records remain readable by permission

uniqueIndexes.name: supplier_active_tax_identity_uq
uniqueIndexes.where: state='ACTIVE' AND taxIdentifier IS NOT NULL

checks: taxIdentifier and taxJurisdiction are both NULL or both non-NULL and snapshot uses canonical Supplier tax identity normalization/validation
SupplierRevision.immutability: Append-only complete profile snapshots; no UPDATE/DELETE after transaction commit

fields.currentRevisionId: uuid NOT NULL; composite FK (currentRevisionId, SupplierOffer.id) -> SupplierOfferRevision(id, offerId), DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
fields.currentMatchProposalId: uuid NULL; composite FK (currentMatchProposalId, SupplierOffer.id) -> ProductMatchProposal(id, offerId), DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

SupplierOffer.deletePolicy: No hard delete; archive keeps revisions, matches and audit; no unique supplier/product/part-number constraint

fields.sourceUrl: varchar(2048) NULL; http(s) only; never fetched by server

checks: non-null purchaseCost requires non-null currency; currency can be present without cost
CONFIRMED_NONE and UNKNOWN require modification NULL
SupplierOfferRevision.immutability: Append-only; no UPDATE/DELETE after transaction commit

fields.offerRevisionId: uuid composite FK SupplierOfferRevision(id, offerId) RESTRICT
fields.offerIdentitySnapshot: jsonb with brandId, manufacturerName, originalPartNumber, modification, modificationEvidence
fields.productIdentitySnapshot: jsonb with brandId, manufacturerName, originalPartNumber, modification

ProductMatchProposal.deletePolicy: Append-only decision history; no delete or reversal; at most one PENDING per offer/revision/product via partial unique index; terminal historical rows permit a new proposal ID after rejection or unlink; no automatic current-pointer restoration

fields.idempotencyKey: varchar(128) NOT NULL COLLATE "C"; exact header key string, case-sensitive
fields.requestHash: bytea(32) NOT NULL SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical request envelope
fields.responseStatus: smallint NOT NULL; successful 2xx or deterministic terminal domain/OCC 409
fields.responseBody: jsonb NOT NULL; exact sanitized mutation receipt/proposal response only, never request body, private supplier fields, source URL or purchase cost

checks: responseStatus is 2xx or deterministic domain/OCC 409; validation/auth/transient failures are not stored
SupplierCommandIdempotency.transaction: Acquire PostgreSQL transaction-scoped advisory lock derived from exact actor/scope/key; check hash, execute command and persist completed response in one transaction. Successful domain mutation and AuditEvent commit atomically with the result. A stored VERSION_CONFLICT has no domain mutation and no success audit.
SupplierCommandIdempotency.retention: Append-only, no hard delete, retained indefinitely in R1; no automatic expiry or purge job
SupplierCommandIdempotency.visibility: Internal command support only; no list/read API and no direct staff DTO
